ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Deck uses the camera only to scan the pairing QR shown by Orca desktop. Video is not saved or sent.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Deck uses the microphone when you start voice input. Your paired Orca host transcribes audio with its selected model. You can edit the draft before sending.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Orca Deck connects to your paired Orca desktop to read work state and send confirmed input and voice requests.
